feature_contract.goal: Remove redundant value-initialization of shipped R26+HUD XYZRHW left/right per-eye vertex output while preserving full original buffer bytes, independent stereo reprojection, and original/fallback behavior.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R26+HUD per-eye transformed vertex staging and its portable host smoke. No source/index shadow rework, DX11/DXVK, lens, HUD classification, SkyGlow, GOAL, FFB or original input changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R26+HUD R30TransformXyzrhwVertices unconditionally vector-resizes BOTH left and right output arrays, zero-filling newly enlarged spans before complete memcpy of all bytes from source. The previous 00873 improvement changed source/index scratch ONLY. Removing this separately confirmed redundant eye-buffer CPU write does not prove Quest3 FPS improvement.
trace_stages: Original game DrawPrimitiveUP, IndexedPrimitiveUP, VB/IB Lock/Unlock submit original indexed/non-indexed XYZRHW vertex windows.
R26+HUD copies the complete validated vertex bytes into independent per-eye buffers before transform.
World, HUD and projected-marker per-eye geometry changes only XYZRHW; unused vertices and texture/attribute payload remain unmodified.
When full reprojection fails or eyes disagree, original source is copied again for affine fallback; D3D9 left/right draw and E_NOTIMPL original fallback are preserved.
subcomponents: Replace both left/right per-eye std::vector with existing capacity-retaining write-only scratch, removing zero-fill on growth.
Check invalid viewport before cloning and keep full memcpy plus bilateral original-source restore unchanged.
Extend existing Active no-HMD host regression with two independent eye buffers, attribute and unused vertex survival, reused capacity and original-source fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All bytes of exact original source are copied for both eyes before per-eye XYZRHW transform, with no vector growth zero fill.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Indexed vertex attributes and bilateral fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Unused indexed vertices and nonposition attributes remain identical, and full reprojection failure resets eye payload from original source.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Exact-SHA shipped Windows game and OpenXR host
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Windows Active game/host/package, Domain Isolation, relevant Full Source Impact and portable changed-area smoke succeed on validation-bearing SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Both R30ScratchBuffers.left/right were std::vector<uint8_t>; each eye's resize grew with zero-initialization, immediately overwritten by complete memcpy(source,bytes).
source_trace: D3D9 original producer submits XYZRHW draw or captured indexed VB/IB.
R30TransformXyzrhwVertices validates input and creates each eye clone.
Only selected XYZRHW vertex positions/depth change; arbitrary trailing attributes remain.
Stereo submit uses separate left/right DrawPrimitiveUP and source-recopy on bilateral fallback.
diagnosis.root_cause: Unnecessary value-initialization on repeated growth of both transformed-eye buffers before a complete memcpy generates avoidable CPU memory writes.
alternatives_rejected: Do not skip memcpy or mutate original source directly.
Do not share one eye's storage with the other or alter per-eye reprojection/fallback.
Do not revisit already completed 00873 source/index scratch improvements.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Output eye buffers use already validated write-only scratch with full-source copy and viewport early reject.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Host smoke covers independent eyes, untouched indexed/texture attributes, resizing without stale reuse, original clone rollback, clear; exact-SHA Windows gate pending.
